Work through the setup list below from top to bottom, then tap Start overlay. A blue mic bubble floats over every app. Tap it and say what you want done, for example \"turn on Bluetooth\" or \"search Chrome for the weather in Berlin\". The assistant may ask a quick question, then it operates the phone for you and tells you how it went. While it works, the bubble turns into a thin bar at the top of the screen; tap ■ there to stop it. Drag the bubble anywhere and it snaps to the nearest edge. Tap it again to end the conversation.\n\nGood to know: Android hides every floating bubble while the Settings app (and some permission screens) are in front. That is a system rule; the assistant keeps working there and the bubble comes back when you leave Settings. The phone only types words that are part of your request: say exactly what to search for or write.
